name: Cloudflare R2
label: Cloudflare R2 S3-compatible API
description: Cloudflare R2 S3-compatible API. Official API https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/api/. One node; pick operation. Upload/download use type file (Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.) Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. S3-compatible SigV4. Host https://{account_id}.{jurisdiction} (default jurisdiction r2.cloudflarestorage.com; EU eu.r2.cloudflarestorage.com; US us.r2.cloudflarestorage.com; FedRAMP fedramp.r2.cloudflarestorage.com).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation S3 fields. object_put takes file plus optional PutObject headers (content_type, cache_control, …). Do not put access keys here.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official S3-compatible call to run. EXACT: bucket_create | bucket_list | object_put | object_get | object_delete | object_list | presign. Example: object_put.

schema.label: bucket
schema.description: S3 bucket name (path). Used by every object/bucket op except bucket_list. Example: invoices.

schema.label: key
schema.description: Object key (path). object_put, object_get, object_delete, presign. Example: reports/2026-10.pdf.

schema.label: list-type
schema.description: object_list query `list-type`. Use 2 for ListObjectsV2. Example: 2.

schema.label: prefix
schema.description: object_list query `prefix` to limit keys. Example: reports/.

schema.label: Expires In
schema.description: Presign URL expiry in seconds (maps to X-Amz-Expires). Example: 3600. Used by: presign.

schema.label: file
schema.description: object_put body: official PutObject bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes. Required for object_put unless config file is set.

schema.label: content_type
schema.description: PutObject header Content-Type. Official R2 system metadata. Example: application/pdf. object_put.

schema.label: cache_control
schema.description: PutObject header Cache-Control. Example: max-age=3600. object_put.

schema.label: content_disposition
schema.description: PutObject header Content-Disposition. Example: attachment; filename=report.pdf. object_put.

schema.label: content_encoding
schema.description: PutObject header Content-Encoding. Example: gzip. object_put.

schema.label: content_language
schema.description: PutObject header Content-Language. Example: en-US. object_put.

schema.label: expires
schema.description: PutObject header Expires (HTTP-date). Example: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 07:28:00 GMT. object_put.

schema.label: content_md5
schema.description: PutObject header Content-MD5 (base64 MD5 of the body). object_put.

schema.label: storage_class
schema.description: PutObject header x-amz-storage-class. EXACT: STANDARD | STANDARD_IA. object_put.

schema.label: if_match
schema.description: Conditional If-Match ETag. object_put and object_get. Example: "33a64df5".

schema.label: if_none_match
schema.description: Conditional If-None-Match. PutObject `*` creates only if the key is absent. object_put and object_get.

schema.label: range
schema.description: object_get header Range. Example: bytes=0-1023.

schema.label: versionId
schema.description: S3 versionId query param for object_get and object_delete when versioning is on.

schema.label: delimiter
schema.description: object_list query `delimiter` for grouping. Example: /.

schema.label: max-keys
schema.description: object_list query `max-keys` page size. Example: 100.

schema.label: continuation-token
schema.description: object_list ListObjectsV2 `continuation-token` from the previous NextContinuationToken.

schema.label: start-after
schema.description: object_list ListObjectsV2 `start-after` key. Example: reports/2026-01.pdf.

schema.label: encoding-type
schema.description: object_list query `encoding-type`. Official: url.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on success.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body or text.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: Secret Access Key
configurationParameters.description: R2 S3 secret access key (SigV4). StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Access Key Id
configurationParameters.description: R2 S3 access key id (SigV4). StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Account Id
configurationParameters.description: Cloudflare account id. S3 host: https://{account_id}.{jurisdiction}

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: SigV4 signing region. Official R2 value is auto (us-east-1 aliases to auto).

configurationParameters.label: Jurisdiction
configurationParameters.description: S3 host suffix after account_id. Default r2.cloudflarestorage.com. EU: eu.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. US: us.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. FedRAMP: fedramp.r2.cloudflarestorage.com.

configurationParameters.label: File
configurationParameters.description: Default upload/convert/sign source. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Expires In
configurationParameters.description: Presign URL expiry in seconds. Example: 3600. Used by: presign.
